name: Ball of Smoke
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level cleric/oracle 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect 5-ft. radius ball of smoke
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You conjure a 5-foot radius ball of thick, black smoke. The smoke is thick enough to provide total concealment (50% miss chance) to anyone within or immediately behind the ball of smoke.
